runs.name: Mitsubishi Corporation
runs.entry: Price **¥4,596** (TSE 8058 close 2026-10-09; Tokyo shut 2026-10-12) and ADS **$29.20** (OTC close 2026-10-12; one share per ADS, depositary's F-6EF of 2026-03-04, 0001193805-26-000216), both aggregator, flagged, x **3,662,694,127 shares** (3,710,528,742 issued less 47,834,615 treasury at 2026-06-30, Q1 FY2026 決算短信, TDnet 140120260731505791, checked against March 2026 and the cancellation of 318,397,611 treasury shares on 2026-04-30) = cap **¥16,834bn** (about $105bn); sovereign **4.136%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-08). Not an SEC registrant: the ticker was checked first against the company's own documents (Mitsubishi Corporation, 8058, not Mitsui & Co., whose run of the same day went out under this slot by the dispatcher's error, see the MITSY entry and its addendum). mitsubishicorp.com refused every fetch (HTTP 403) and EDINET's API needs a key, so the primary documents are the company's own filings from the Tokyo exchange's archive (`www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/80580/`): the annual 決算短信 for the years ended March 2017 to March 2026, the English results for the years ended March 2024 to 2026 (two through LSE RNS), the Q1 FY2026 決算短信 and the timely notices; operating cash flow FY2025 ¥1,490,041M cross-checked English against Japanese. The yuho and integrated report were not read. `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing (not an SEC filer); every figure by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the results' segment note and Business Risks, as the overnight brief directs. Recent capital events from the filings: three-for-one split 2024-01-01; Lawson deconsolidated after KDDI's tender offer (2024); Blackwater and Daunia sold to Whitehaven (closed 2024-04-02); a ¥1tn buyback 2025-04 to 2026-03; Aethon (Haynesville gas) bought for US$5.2bn, completed 2026-07-14. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: by the by-parts CONVENTION, no part carries half of five-year segment profit to owners (the only segment measure filed, a CONVENTION of the run), so the largest decides: Mineral Resources, 33.9% of FY2021 to FY2025 (¥1,587.8bn of ¥4,686.8bn), largest again in Q1 FY2026. Its earning power is set by steelmaking coal and copper prices: profit ¥(360.7)bn (Metals, FY2015 impairments), ¥78.1bn FY2020 to ¥420.7bn FY2021, then halving by FY2025; the Anglo American Sur stake bought for US$4.51bn is carried at ¥216.5bn after impairments and a reversal that followed outside forecasters' revisions; the company's own 2018 results class mineral resources as its 'Market-related sector'. Cited M2011-047, M2016-025, M1998-044, M2006-076; NATURE over WORK by L1993-023 and M2008-086. Weighed against, as found: the speakers' trading-house row M2023-031 (read 'as a group', which the by-parts CONVENTION refuses; the framework keeps it OPEN), L2023-008, M2006-004 and M2009-059 on low-cost producers. Q2 to Q12 not reached; integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash less lease principal, minority dividends and net capital spending; interest added back after tax at 30.62%, a CONVENTION of the run) five-year average **¥950.0bn** all-equity (¥847.9bn equity-only; ten-year ¥700.1bn); net purchases averaged −¥97bn a year (a net seller), so the central figure is before purchases (a CONVENTION of the run, the after-divestment figure beside); shown growth of 29.3% a year capped as absurd (M1999-067) at revenue growth of 2.31%; net debt ¥3,939.8bn at 2026-06-30 plus ¥821.9bn for Aethon, credited at nothing (no filed cash record; about ¥224 a share if credited at cost). Value range **¥4,971 to ¥6,310** ($31.45 to $39.92 per ADS) at 4.136%, against ¥4,596; fair price **¥1,515 all-equity ($9.58)**, ¥2,512 equity-only ($15.89); the central owner cash earns 4.40% to 5.29% on the enterprise at the price, so no case reaches the floor, and had Q1 passed Q7 would close OUT. Fair not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets March 2016 to March 2026: equity to owners ¥4,593bn to ¥9,441bn with borrowings ¥6,043bn to ¥5,747bn; ¥2,386bn of the March 2026 equity is translation differences; inventories +18% in the last year against revenue +1.6%. Recorded, not judged: the ¥1tn buyback averaged ¥3,141 a share with no price limit; annual profit guidance published; a featured 'underlying operating cash flow' figure. Competitors: the documents read name none; Q2 not reached, none read. Contamination declared by the analyst: commit subjects of the MITSY run filed under this ticker and a memory index line in the session context; nothing used. Commits a388740b to 1ae2b065 (Step 0; Q1 with the sections before it; the computation and close). Citations: the analyst's check 37 citations to 28 ids, 0 problems; the dispatcher's adjacency script (`dispatcher_check.py`) 28 ids present, 21 adjacent fragments, 0 slips, no E-ids. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. Analyst's gaps for the operator: (1) the by-parts CONVENTION speaks of operating profit, which a trading house does not report by segment, and with no part over half a third of the earnings closes the whole, so M2023-031 can never govern a trading house; (2) Q1 does not say whether a business whose earning power is set by an unforecastable commodity price belongs at Q1, Q2 or Q7; (3) specific (c) is silent on a net seller over the window; (4) a deal closed after the window with no filed cash record is credited at nothing; (5) the all-equity add-back needs a tax rate the filings do not state.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a Japanese trading house in eight groups where no part has half the profit, so Mineral Resources decides at 33.9%; its profit is steelmaking coal and copper prices (¥78bn to ¥421bn in one year, ¥(361)bn of impairments in FY2015, the Chilean copper stake written down), which the rows say no one forecasts. Weighed against: the speakers' own reading of the five houses 'as a group' (M2023-031), which the by-parts CONVENTION refuses and the framework keeps OPEN. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range ¥4,971 to ¥6,310 at the 4.136% JGB against ¥4,596, fair ¥1,515 all-equity (¥2,512 equity-only), 4.4% to 5.3% at the price, not armed. Ticker checked first: Mitsubishi Corporation, not the Mitsui run that went out under this slot earlier the same day.
